description:
Create an invite link for a channel. Supply target_user_ids for an invite restricted to specific Discord users, and role_ids to grant roles on acceptance. Either option creates a new invite code.

Args:
  - channel_id (string): Discord channel ID
  - max_age (number): Duration in seconds (0 = never expires, max 604800 = 7 days)
  - max_uses (number): Max uses (0 = unlimited)
  - temporary (boolean): Kick members when they disconnect if not assigned a role
  - unique (boolean): Create new unique invite vs reuse existing
  - target_user_ids (string[], optional): Only these users can see and accept the invite (1-1000 IDs)
  - role_ids (string[], optional): Roles granted on acceptance. Requires Manage Roles and sufficient role hierarchy.

Returns:
  Created invite URL

max_age.description: Invite expiration in seconds (0 = never, max 604800 = 7 days)

role_ids.description: Roles granted to users who accept the invite. Requires Manage Roles and sufficient role hierarchy.

target_user_ids.description: Limit acceptance of the invite to these Discord users (1-1000 IDs)

unique.description: Whether to create a unique invite. Invites with target users or roles always use a new code.

name: discord_create_invite
title: Create Invite
